guardrails.description: Airflow base URL must not point at a local host in production-like runtimes.
CORS origins must not point at localhost in production-like runtimes.
CORS must not allow wildcard origins with credentialed requests.
CORS must list at least one explicit allowed origin.
Database URL must not point at a local host in production-like runtimes.
Interactive API documentation must be disabled in production-like runtimes.
Local external training package execution must be disabled in production-like runtimes.
JWT signing secret must be at least 32 characters.
JWT signing secret must not use a local development default.
MLflow tracking URI must not point at a local host in production-like runtimes.
Object storage endpoint must not point at a local host in production-like runtimes.
API rate limiting must be enabled in production-like runtimes.
Dependency readiness checks must be enabled in production-like runtimes.
Redis URL must not point at a local host in production-like runtimes.
HTTP request logging must be enabled in production-like runtimes.
Structured JSON logging must be enabled in production-like runtimes.
